target-size-min.name: Target Size (Minimum)
target-size-min.why: A tappable target is smaller than 24×24 dp and too close to another target (the 24 dp spacing circles overlap).
target-size-min.fix: Make the target at least 24×24 dp (48×48 dp is Android's guideline), or space targets so 24 dp circles around each don't overlap. Compose: Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize().

label-in-name.name: Label in Name
label-in-name.why: The control shows text, but its accessible name (content description) doesn't contain it. Voice-control users say what they see, and it won't match.
label-in-name.fix: Start the content description with the visible text, or remove it so the visible text is used.

not-focusable.name: Keyboard
not-focusable.why: The control is clickable but not focusable, so keyboard and switch-access users can't reach it.
not-focusable.fix: Make it focusable (android:focusable / Compose clickable or focusable modifiers).

no-role.name: Name, Role, Value
no-role.why: A clickable generic View exposes no role, so TalkBack doesn't say it's a button, tab, or switch.
no-role.fix: Use a real widget, or set the role: Modifier.semantics { role = Role.Button } / AccessibilityNodeInfo.setClassName.

screen-title.name: Page Titled
screen-title.why: No title could be found for this screen, so a screen-reader user may not know where they are.
screen-title.fix: Give each screen a title: activity title, toolbar title, or accessibilityPaneTitle / Modifier.semantics { paneTitle = … } for fragments and Compose destinations.

nav-inconsistent.name: Consistent Navigation
nav-inconsistent.why: The bottom navigation differs in order or content between screens.
nav-inconsistent.fix: Keep repeated navigation in the same relative order on every screen.
nav-inconsistent.native_note: Written for sets of web pages; WCAG2ICT and EN 301 549 don't require it for a single native app, so treat it as strong best practice there.

identification-inconsistent.name: Consistent Identification
identification-inconsistent.why: The same control (same resource id) is labelled differently on different screens.
identification-inconsistent.fix: Use the same label for the same function everywhere.
identification-inconsistent.native_note: Written for sets of web pages; WCAG2ICT and EN 301 549 don't require it for a single native app, so treat it as strong best practice there.

help-inconsistent.name: Consistent Help
help-inconsistent.why: A help/support/contact entry appears on several screens, but not in the same relative place.
help-inconsistent.fix: Put repeated help mechanisms in the same relative order on every screen.
help-inconsistent.native_note: Written for sets of web pages; WCAG2ICT and EN 301 549 don't require it for a single native app, so treat it as strong best practice there.

redundant-entry.name: Redundant Entry
redundant-entry.why: The same information was typed on more than one screen of one flow.
redundant-entry.fix: Auto-fill information the user already gave, or let them select it.

auth-cognitive.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
auth-cognitive.why: This screen asks for a password, code, or puzzle. Authentication must not depend on a cognitive test unless paste, password managers, or another method are supported.
auth-cognitive.fix: Allow paste and autofill (autofillHints password/username/oneTimeCode), offer passkeys or email links, and avoid text CAPTCHAs.

dragging.name: Dragging Movements
dragging.why: A slider, drag handle, or swipe-only control needs a single-tap alternative.
dragging.fix: Add buttons (e.g. +/−, move up/down) or accessibility custom actions for anything done by dragging.

focus-obscured.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
focus-obscured.why: A focusable control sits completely under a sticky bar or floating button, so it is hidden when it gets focus.
focus-obscured.fix: Add bottom padding/insets to scrolling content equal to the sticky bar's height, or scroll focused items into the visible area.

orientation-locked.name: Orientation
orientation-locked.why: The activity is locked to one orientation in the manifest.
orientation-locked.fix: Remove android:screenOrientation unless an orientation is essential (e.g. a piano app).

text-truncated.name: Resize Text
text-truncated.why: Text is cut off with an ellipsis. At larger font sizes this usually means lost content.
text-truncated.fix: Let text wrap (no maxLines/ellipsize on important text), use sp, and test at 200% font scale.

change-on-input.name: On Input
change-on-input.why: Typing into a field changed the screen without the user asking for it.
change-on-input.fix: Only navigate on an explicit action (a submit button), or warn users before it happens.

image-alt.name: Non-text Content
image-alt.why: A sizeable image has no text alternative. Fine if decorative; otherwise it needs one.
image-alt.fix: Set contentDescription for meaningful images, and null / importantForAccessibility=no for decorative ones.
